description: This file defines the SugarFieldCollection class, which extends SugarFieldBase to manage collection-type custom fields in the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for rendering detail, edit, and search views, as well as saving related links and data entries.

classes.name: SugarFieldCollection
classes.description: A class for handling collection fields in SuiteCRM, providing methods for rendering views and saving related data.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares and renders the detail view of the collection field using Smarty templates.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares and renders the edit view (or search view) of the collection field using Smarty templates.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Calls getEditViewSmarty for search view rendering.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the linked collection data and manages related records upon bean save.
